maxResults.label: Max Results
maxResults.help: Maximum memories to inject per turn

autoRecall.label: Auto-Recall
autoRecall.help: Automatically inject relevant memories into context

autoCapture.label: Auto-Capture
autoCapture.help: Automatically store important information from conversations

temporal.enabled.label: Temporal Facts
temporal.enabled.help: Enable temporal facts with validity periods (e.g., 'Alice worked at Acme from 2020-2023')

graph.enabled.label: Graph Traversal
graph.enabled.help: Enable knowledge graph traversal to find related concepts

graph.traversalHops.label: Traversal Hops
graph.traversalHops.help: Number of hops to traverse in the knowledge graph

graph.extractEntities.label: Extract Entities
graph.extractEntities.help: Automatically extract and link entities from captured memories

sectors.enabled.label: Cognitive Sectors
sectors.enabled.help: Store memories in cognitive sectors (episodic, semantic, procedural, emotional, reflective)

sectors.defaultSector.label: Default Sector
sectors.defaultSector.help: Default sector for memories that don't match a pattern

recall.includeTraces.label: Include Traces
recall.includeTraces.help: Show explanations for why memories were recalled

recall.temporalContext.label: Temporal Context
recall.temporalContext.help: Include current temporal facts about extracted entities in recall

compression.autoCompress.label: Auto-Compress
compression.autoCompress.help: Automatically compress redundant memories when threshold is reached

compression.threshold.label: Compression Threshold
compression.threshold.help: Number of compressible memories before auto-compression triggers
